corrections.reason: The plural verb ending ሆኑ (matching the plural subject ሰብአ ዓለም / የሚራቀቁ and parallel to Col 2 L19 የሚራቀቁ ስለ ሆኑ) has the 2nd-order vowel stroke on the right leg of ኑ, which was misread as 1st-order ነ.
The printed text at the end of Line 18 clearly has the three-character archaic contracted form ሁኗል (ሁ-ኗ-ል), which Stage 1 expanded/misread as ሆነዋል.
Joined with እን- at the end of Line 10, this forms the standard Andemta citation formula እንዲል ('as it says'). The 3rd-order ዲ was misread as 4th-order ዳ.
The printed word is አንዳንድ ('a certain / some rich man'), where the 1st-order አ and 4th-order ዳ were misread as እ and ደ.
Both visually and grammatically the relative verb is የምሰጠው ('that which I give him' with 1st-order ጠ), whereas 6th-order ጥ had a faint left leg in the print.
